images.prompt: Vertical epic cinematic film still, photorealistic, anamorphic lens, fine film grain. A bright tall bonfire burning on an open hilltop at deep blue pre-dawn twilight, smoke rising straight up into a dark navy sky that fades to a faint orange glow at the horizon, misty valley below. Seamless natural sky, full-bleed photo, no borders, no frames. No people, no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
